_about: Backup for the website: notes for old releases (their GitHub release text is empty) and the full-game files, used if GitHub can't be reached. New releases made with publish_update.py carry their notes on GitHub and show up on the site by themselves - you don't have to edit this file.

releases.notes: Much smoother nights on Hard and Difficult (up to almost 2x the FPS). New Graphics preset (Low / Medium / High) in Settings; built-in graphics cards start on Low automatically. New 'Copy hardware info' button in Settings for bug reports.

New look for the whole game (Frontier UI). Fixed the world looking all brown / mud on some phones. New: the game checks its own files and repairs only broken ones (Settings > Check & repair game files). Mac: easier first start (Fix and open helper).
